about: The map just test-changed reads (tools/cmd/test-changed). Each changed path belongs to exactly one component: the one with
the longest matching entry in its paths, where an entry ending in / matches every path under that directory and any other
entry matches that one file. The component's tests are what runs. A path no entry matches fails just test-changed, naming it.
A test id is a target below, or gtest:<binary> (just test-auth-unit <binary>), just:<recipe>, go:<package under tools/>
(go -C tools test ./<package>) or pytest:<name> (python3 tools/run_tool_tests.py tools/tests/<name>.py). A component with
no tests says why in none. {preset} in a target is $PRESET, else mingw-release.

components.name: (root):.clang-format
components.none: repository metadata: no test reads this file

components.name: (root):CODE_OF_CONDUCT
components.none: documentation: no test reads this file

components.name: .claude
components.none: agent instructions: no test reads this file (a skill's Go consumer implements its check and never opens it)

components.name: .github
components.none: GitHub configuration: no test reads this file

components.name: certs
components.none: local signing CA scripts (just generate-certs, just sign): no test runs them

components.name: sdk/include/nevr/pc
components.none: SDK header for PC plugins: no target in this tree compiles it (plugins build in nevr-runtime-plugins)

components.name: src/libovr-stub
components.none: the libovr stub is not part of any build or test target in this tree

components.name: tools:gen_hwdump_vk_fields
components.none: a one-off tool or data file: no test runs or reads it

components.name: tools/echomod
components.none: ADR 0044 'Where Python stays': no test in tools/tests names tools/echomod
